## Demonstration

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

# Read in data with here (directly goes to folder then to file itself)
interviews_plotting <- read_csv(here("data", "interviews-plotting.csv"))


interviews_plotting

```


```{r}
interviews_plotting |> 
  ggplot(mapping = aes(y = fct_infreq(respondent_wall_type))) +
  geom_bar(mapping = aes(fill = village)) +
  labs(y = "Wall Type", x = NULL, title = "Bar Graph of Wall Type to Village",
       fill = "Village") +
  theme_linedraw()

```
